title: The Promo Video Shooting Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ran, Sonoko, Kogoro, the Detective Boys) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Two linked killings, one culprit: Kitagawa Miki first pitches a fake-murder prank video to Miyasaka and Takayama (Takayama as the in-on-it 'body confirmer'), then secretly returns to Miyasaka's auto-locking room and stabs him for real with a swapped knife once he lets her in expecting the reveal, repositioning the body so the room reads as untouched since the 'staging'. When Takayama grows visibly anxious that Miyasaka never resurfaced to reveal the prank, she lures him to the cliff and pushes him off, then fabricates having seen him flee past a lobby window -- a lie exposed because a lit room's windows only reflect its own interior after dark, not the outside. Discrepancy vs. the old lower-fidelity case file: its clue c1 described the tell as 'blood stains on the swapped knife' -- the transcript's actual forensic tell is the opposite and more specific: a cola stain visible on the knife's handle in Okita's video footage is *absent* from the knife at the body on second inspection, proving two different knives were used (the culprit ID itself, s2/Miki, was correct in the old file). The old file also entirely omitted the accomplice mechanic (Takayama's role and death), the dying-message wordplay on the liquid foundation bottle ('ekitai' reversed reads 'dokkiri', i.e. prank), and the window-reflection clue that catches Miki's false testimony. case_type: murder.
